verdict.rationale: Voice handling is a fair question for a support platform with AI agents, so the axis applies. The evidence documents Slack, email, Teams, chat widget and forms channels, but nothing shows the Support Agent answering phone calls with speech in and speech out. The post-call task generation feature is an adjacent capability, not the agent handling calls.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent handles phone calls — speech in, speech out — with the same knowledge and actions as chat
